THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 01 / OCTOBER 2026
RIBBONS & LINES
014
13 / Cherry Red
Close-up studio portrait with a glossy red headband,
black fringe, red puff sleeves and pale pink backdrop. Symmetry,
direct gaze and saturated red establish the composition.
14 / Monochrome Line
Full-body minimalist lookbook: black ribbed turtleneck,
white mini skirt, white knee socks and pointed black shoes. The
white background keeps attention on silhouette and contrast.
